1.quote: When someone has unwavering faith in an endeavour, they are unlikely to fail, regardless of whether their belief is right or wrong.

2.quote: The revelations of nature lie in seemingly trivial events.

3.quote: It is only when adversity strikes and lives are lost that humanity begins to realize how gravely it has underestimated the danger.

4.quote: Help others in a manner that keeps your involvement anonymous. This is how God works.

5.quote: Refrain from expressing past hardships upon achieving success; with time, they will become apparent.

6.quote: You don't have to wait for the stars to align to take action. Take action, and then the stars will align.

7.quote: Even the tiniest seed possesses enough strength to push a delicate sapling through the hardest, rockiest soil.

8.quote: The only way to gain a stranger's trust is to be good at their game.

9.quote: Never show your anger towards a mob, for a single drop cannot drown you, but an ocean can.

10.quote: Fire can be used both to light up and to burn down the world; so can a human being.

11.quote: A bag contains 1,000 red balls and 1 blue ball. You close your eyes and pick one. Luck is when you get a blue ball. A miracle is when you get a green ball.

12.quote: Stay innocent. When your heart and mind are pure, you see things that others can't, you get help that others won't, and you show love that others don't.

13.quote: It is only when you have done all you can and are still lost that you should turn to him.

14.quote:
Compassion toward your enemies is a sign of a pure heart, for you are not blinded by their hatred.
Confrontation with your friends is a sign of a pure mind, for you are not blinded by their love.

15.quote: Belief makes you plant the seed. Intention brings you its fruits.

16.quote: If you do something with love and care, it feels like a hobby to you, while it looks like hard work to others.

17.quote: Take care of the words you speak; in time, they will start to shape your reality.

18.quote: What differentiates you from others defines you.

19.quote: Only three things can cause a transformation: fear of the future, love in the present, and pain from the past. In rare cases, a revelation.

20.quote: On a long journey, worry more about losing your comfort than about reaching your destination.

21.quote: The strong have the courage to apologize. The mighty have the wisdom to foresee such situations and avoid them.

22.quote: Effort does not take time. Results take time. Ironically, effort itself is a result.

23.quote: Pain by fate is an experience. Pain by choice is a conviction. One happens to you; the other reveals you.

24.quote: Better to conceal the truth than to tell a lie, for avoiding pain is wiser than seeking pleasure.

25.quote: Keep them in. Let them die inside; they will spring up beautifully sometime later. Otherwise, if you let them out, they will only serve to bury you.

26.quote: Love is born only after destiny is fulfilled. When destiny is complete, the good and bad in you die, leaving behind nothing but innocence, and from that innocence, love is born.

27.quote: Artistry, Attention, Belief and Benevolence. Together, reality will bend and bow in your favour.

28.quote: Your trust in my beliefs should not be based solely on my position in life, but rather on your own instincts. Your decisions reveal a lot about your position in life.

29.quote: Redemption comes only when you let something inside you go.

30.quote: Every smile you've unknowingly brought to someone's face carries a meaning deeper than you realize.

31.quote: Focusing on different layers of a music piece can make you feel like you are listening to different music pieces.

32.quote: In a vast universe, nothing may seem miraculous; in a small one, everything may seem miraculous.

33.quote:
Change your heart, everything about you will change.
Change your mind, everything around you will change.

34.quote: Either cover your eyes, or make sure the light doesn't reflect off your iris.

35.quote: The candle has to burn and deteriorate for us to feel safe in the dark. Someone has to suffer.

36.quote: Many events in life follow an exponential or logarithmic pattern. Know where you stand, in time and space.

37.quote: Something magical definitely happened in the past. Different people saw it in different ways, giving birth to different beliefs.

38.quote: You have reached the top of the mountain. Congratulations. Now, you must come down, as staying there is not safe.

39.quote: Water must be offered to the pump first, only then do we get more of it.

40.quote: Failing to recognize the struggles of those around you will only leave you with a struggle that is even harder for others to recognize.

41.quote: Trust that a crisis of enthusiasm doesn't warrant a lifetime of suffering.

42.quote: A colourful face wants you to smile, because it earns him his bread for a while. A colourful heart wants you to smile, because it believes your smile is worthwhile.

43.quote: A seed, a pill, and a word — just put in some effort and let the magic unfold.

44.quote: If you are born into an adverse lifestyle, you will spend much of your life simply trying to overcome those struggles; success isn't even a consideration here, while for others, suffering isn't even a thought.

45.quote: Too much wanting leaves too little room for what is yet to come.

46.quote: Profit and service are rarely mentioned in the same sentence.

47.quote: When the heart is influenced first, inspiring the mind is easy. But when the mind is influenced first, inspiring the heart becomes much more difficult. Nature favours the former.

48.quote: It is almost certain that whatever you do with love will come back to you during times of adversity.

49.quote: Few right hands do more good than many free hands.

50.quote: Unintentional and unconscious actions often lead to unexpected revelations, something that you will only realize after the moment has passed.

51.quote: Without sweat, blood or tears, it can't be called 'hard work'.

52.quote: Expecting perfect and controlled outcomes is foolish. Using that as an excuse not to make a sincere effort is even more foolish.

53.quote: The person who struggles most deeply with the guilt of being unable to change something may eventually become the very person who creates meaningful change.

54.quote: If you don't like walking while looking ahead, try walking with your head slightly raised, looking at the trees and the sky.

55.quote: Confidence makes you act; doubt makes you hesitate. Confidence takes you somewhere, even if you fail. Doubt takes you nowhere; it only makes you wait.

56.quote: Only love can make you achieve what neither talent nor discipline can.

57.quote: A noble man who walks the path of righteous, will eventually find his destiny. Like one journeying through a dense jungle, where the canopy parts and sunlight breaks through to touch him.

58.quote: How do you react? You relax. You recede. You retry. You reclaim.

59.quote: The only acceptable greed is the greed to help.

60.quote: With every person life brings into your life, love like you have never loved anyone before.

61.quote: Beliefs cannot be taught. They can only be learned.

62.quote: The invisible side of responsibility is sacrifice.

63.quote:
The buyer should be afraid of not finding any sellers.
The seller should be afraid of not finding any buyers.

65.quote: It is a privilege to live for the well-being of others.

66.quote: If you see the struggle, you won't feel jealous.

67.quote: The memory of you is a visitor to the temple of the mind. Whomever your enter, leave it a better place.

68.quote: After you have reached new heights, come back to where it all started.

69.quote: When offered in abundance, take limited or decline entirely.

70.quote: When you can't make a choice, flip a coin and let fate decide.

71.quote: Save what is near. Trust what is lost to find its way back.

72.quote: Mastery of any art is more likely when one starts young.

73.quote: The cruelest thing about being a human, is having a heart capable of producing endless love, yet a mind that can only bear so much of it.

74.quote: Small things done regularly are powerful because they compound, whether they are helping you or hurting you.

75.quote: Examine from others. Execute for others. Educate others.

76.quote: Who knows? The smallest contribution may leave the greatest legacy.
